issues.description: The original pushed to all replicas concurrently via Promise.all. The refactor adds retry/backoff (the visible change) but does it inside a sequential `for...of` loop that `await`s each replica before starting the next, so total latency is now the sum of all replica round-trips instead of the max. The replicas are independent; the retry logic could be wrapped per-replica and still run in parallel (e.g. Promise.all over a retrying helper). The buried regression is the lost concurrency, not the retry itself.
